facility.name: Courtney's Home Daycare
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Age-appropriate: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the children had access to a tablet and were not using the tablet in an appropriate way.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Animals - Do Not Create Unsafe or Unsanitary Conditions: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that animal urine was on the floor in the home where the children were playing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals - Do Not Create Unsafe or Unsanitary Conditions (26 TAC §747.3701(2))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the cups the children drank from were not labeled with their names.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §747.2405(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Notify Immediately about Allegation of Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the parents were not informed of the incident that led to the DFPS investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Notify Immediately about Allegation of Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation (26 TAC §747.305(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Enrollment Agreement: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that one of the children present at the location did not have an application form completed by the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that a 16-year-old was present at the operation for the day and did not have an active background check.  An administrative penalty will be recommended as a result of this citation, per HRC ?42.078
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check (26 TAC §745.621(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the caregiver could not hear or see the children when they were upstairs in the bedroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the TV was on around children under the age of two years.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the director did not  make a good judgment when she deleted the photos on the tablet related to the investigation.  She allowed children upstairs unsupervised and used foul language in front of the children  when speaking with the DFPS Investigator and the CCR Inspector
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the operation was out of ratio with one caregiver and twelve children. The second caregiver was upstairs working at another job in the office. The ages of the children ranged in age; 2 children were 17 months younger, and 10 children were 18 months or older.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)

occurrences.finding: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the director of the operation did not inform childcare licensing within 48 hours after the incident occurred that led to an investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect and Exploitation (26 TAC §747.207(4))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides- Six Feet High or Less: A play structure with a slide did not have the required 6 feet use zone all around.     Note: This was corrected during inspection when written letter was signed and provided to CCR, indicating slide will not be used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides- Six Feet High or Less (26 TAC §747.4605(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The privacy fence has loose boards creating gaps that children can put their hands through. Note: This was corrected during inspection when boards were put back up and fence had no large gaps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR also Includes Expiration Date  or Renewal: First aid certification was not available during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR also Includes Expiration Date  or Renewal (26 TAC §747.1327(c)(1)(B))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: One out of the four children's records were not available during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Animals - Do Not Create Unsafe or Unsanitary Conditions: Remnants of 47 piles of dog feces were observed in the backyard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals - Do Not Create Unsafe or Unsanitary Conditions (26 TAC §747.3701(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The privacy fence has a loose board creating a gap that children can put their hands through.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Handrails on Stairs and Steps of  Climbing Equipment: The steps on the backside of the playscape were missing handrails on one side.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handrails on Stairs and Steps of  Climbing Equipment (26 TAC §747.4401(10))

occurrences.finding: Animals - Do Not Create Unsafe or Unsanitary Conditions: Several piles of dog feces were in the backyard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals - Do Not Create Unsafe or Unsanitary Conditions (26 TAC §747.3701(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Four of eight children's files audited did not have immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: Documentation of safety drills were not available at the time of inspeciton.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings: A swing was broken on one side, leaving the chain dangling and accessible to children. This was corrected at inspection when the chain was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings (26 TAC §747.4401(4))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: Two dogs the director is dog sitting did not have vaccination records available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Never exceed capacity of the home: There were 13 childre in care upon arrival. This was corrected at inspection when three children were removed from care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The privacy fence has loose boards creating gaps that children can put their hands through.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training: Substitute assistant did not have 24 required training hours ready for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A large tree branch was noted in the outdoor yard accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Animals - Do Not Create Unsafe or Unsanitary Conditions: Animal feces was noted in the backyard where children have access.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals - Do Not Create Unsafe or Unsanitary Conditions (26 TAC §747.3701(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: Numerous outdoor toys were found broken and not maintained in the outdoor space that children have access to.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §747.4401(7))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: Documentation for two dogs in the home was not ready for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home with 3 or More Caregivers: At the time of inspection there were eleven children in care.  Three of the children were ages 12 months to 15 months, making the ratio for one caregiver to have a total of seven children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home with 3 or More Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1805)

occurrences.finding: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level-Written Approval: At the time of inspection one child was napping on the second level of the home.    This was corrected when the child was placed on the first level of the home with the rest of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level-Written Approval (26 TAC §747.4015(1))
